Ideal'; 'It is very motivating when you see your progress for the year'; widgets the third strength (PRAISE_WIDGETS 8: 'keep a widget on my home screen, and tick the specific habit… and that's it!').

The main risk in this corpus is a change to the free model: the developer's terms reserve the right to 'charge for their services at any time'; two reviewers attach their loyalty to the price (U:future_pricing 2, 2.33%): 'I really hope it stays free, otherwise I will have to find a different habit tracker'; 'I hope it won't become a subscription, or at least that there will be an option to buy it once!' (ru) — the only statements in the corpus that make continued use conditional on anything, and the condition is price; the free model is the reason 45.35% give, and three name habit limits or subscriptions as what they avoid elsewhere.
